subject: Shiny Server connects to LDAP but does not fetch the Groups

messages.author: 74032842c050c506
messages.subject: Shiny Server connects to LDAP but does not fetch the Groups
parts:
I am using LDAP to configure access to Shiny Apps  . I am able to base bind and also use user filter successfully. However my group filter doesnt fetch any group 

Below is the configuration in Shiny 

group_filter "uniqueMember={userDN}";
group_search_base "";    # to search at the sub tree level

The output in the log is below
 [TRACE] shiny-server - Retrieving groups for user 'CN=lobolan,OU=People,DC=example,DC=com' using filter: '(uniqueMember=CN=lobolan,OU=People,DC=example,DC=com)' in 'DC=example,DC=com'
 [TRACE] shiny-server - Discovered groups: 


Please suggest what is going wrong here and how do I go about this 

Thanks
